name: slskdN
longDescription:
slskdN is an AGPL-3.0 Soulseek client with a web interface, multi-source downloads, library sharing, discovery, DHT, and optional mesh networking.

Forward TCP 50300 for incoming Soulseek traffic and enable UDP 50300 when DHT or mesh rendezvous is required.
description: Soulseek client with discovery, downloads, and mesh features.
